main_text.p: linea Ghozaimah خزيمة, extra lineam هذيل Hodhail, الهذليين Hodhalienfium pater, (è quibus أبو ذؤيب Abu Dhowaib Poeta,) & غالب Galeb, & سعد Saad, & قيس Kais.

Choxaima in recta serie natus كنانة Cenanah, extra seriem الهون Albawn, & أسد Asad, Hawno oriundæ Tribus عضل Adal, quarum pater Adal, Hawni filius. Et الديش AlDaish qui Hawni frater. Dictæ hæ tribus القارة AlKarab, sc. (monente AlJauhario) quod in unum collectæ & συμπλεγμένα[?] fuerint. Afado oriundi الكاهلية Cahelienses, & دودان Dudan, aliique qui omnes ab eo Afadienses denominati.

Cenanæ in recta linea natus النضر AlNadr. cui fratres complures, sc. ملكان Malcan, عبد مناة Abd Manah, عمرو Amrus, عامر Amer, مالك Malec. Malcano oriundi Banu Makan; Abd Manaho autem Tribus complures. 1. بنو غفار Banu Gefar. 2. بنو بكر Banu Bacr, è quibus الديل AlDiyal. Diyalien-ses. 3. بنو ليث Banu Laith. 4. بنو الحارث Banu'l Hareth. 5. بنو مدلج Banu Modlaj. 6. بنو ضمرة Banu Damrah.

Ab Amro autem, Cenana filio, ortum ducunt العامريون Amrienses, ab Amero العامريون Amerienses. A Malceo بنو فراس Banu Pheras. E Tribubus etiam Cenana الاحابيش Habashita quos falso nonnulli, nomine decepti, pro Abyssinis habent.

Nadro quem falso nonnulli Koraishum vocant, natus in recta serie مالك Malec. Maleco فهر Phehr, qui & قريش Koraish, seu ille potius à quo denominati Koraishita ob audaciam, sc. è قريش quod bellua Marina nomen. Phehro in recta linea غالب Galeb, ex-

page.notes: Arabic and Greek words are transcribed from the scan as best as legible; the Arabic forms of several names (Hawni, Makan, Amrus, Diyal) and the Greek word after "&" (συμπλεγμένα) are uncertain and should be checked against the original. The Arabic and Greek glyphs in the upper lines are small and may contain errors. The word "tra" at the foot is the catchword and is not repeated in the text.
